== Official composed source and chronology ==
Documented image layouts follow supported source order. Repository timestamps identify preserved full-face copies; archive capture and printed edition identify partial occurrences. Unknown first publication days are not assigned.
* '''Original full face''' ([[Lak Sivrak]]): preserved in [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 the first Holotable repository import, 8 July 2018]. The card may predate that import.
* '''Errata 1, earlier partial''' ([[Lak Sivrak (Errata)]]): present in the complete official PDF archived at 2021-10-05T19:33:58Z; prints no errata mark.<ref>[[:File:Virtual-Set-9-archive-2021-10-05-pages-1-4-extract.pdf|Official Set 9 PDF archived 5 October 2021]], original page 4 (lossless extract page 2).</ref>
* '''Errata 2, current full face''' ([[Lak Sivrak (Errata 2)]]): the [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/44c7bc5c258703260424a3793cd55f0221d672e4/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/hires/laksivrak.png source PNG] was authored and committed 2022-07-10T17:26:49Z. The later [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 GIF copy] was committed 19:39:59Z that UTC day; their complete RGB pixels and dimensions are identical. Prints no errata mark. This state retains the supported <code>209_8</code> mapping.
* '''Errata 3, later partial''' ([[Lak Sivrak (Errata 3)]]): October 2023 sheet edition; prints no errata mark. Header/lore typography, frame and badge layout differ from the earlier partial. The two sheet occurrences are distinct published layouts, not merely different encodings.<ref>[[:File:Virtual-Set-9-October-2023.pdf|Official Set 9 sheet, October 2023 edition]], page 4.</ref>
The actual printed marks are recorded separately from image-version ordinals in [[Players Committee transcription errors]]. [[File:V9-L-laksivrak-Set9-2021-2023-partial-comparison.png|thumb|center|300px|Earlier and later published partial layouts.]]

No new executable ID is created for a partial. The existing supported ID stays on the moved full-face article. The complete composed source region from original page 4 is retained, including vector text/icons over background xref 509; extracting that background alone would omit printed content. Upper fields and rule-derived values are explicitly distinguished from printed partial fields. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 13 November 2026 (UTC).

== Scout characteristic: context question ==
The [[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|Advanced Rulebook (2023)]], Appendix D, pages 177–178, requires a character, the exact characteristic term (plural permitted), and context referring to that card. Lak satisfies the first two criteria. The plural species wording and the description of Lak as a typical individual leave the context criterion open to interpretation; the separate extension for many members of a group is expressly limited to non-unique cards. No Lak-specific exception or adjudication was located in that rulebook or the nine posts inspected in the [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=83345 Current Rulings and Errata thread]. This audit does not establish a categorical Scout or not-Scout conclusion. Printed lore, statistics/icons and the directly supported Shistavanen identification remain unchanged.

The [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1444627#p1444627 11 January 2026 SLA database report by nobthehobbit] explains in its preface that negative property descriptions identify missing database entries for properties the reporter thinks the card has. Its Lak entry is a metadata-omission report, not a ruling that Lak lacks Scout or Shistavanen. The inspected acknowledgments by Gergall do not specifically adjudicate Lak. No engine change follows from this source audit. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 14 November 2026 (UTC).
